definitions.explanation: To leave one's home or current location to go somewhere. Implies going out for a purpose like shopping, work, or leisure.

examples.japanese: これから{出|で}かけます。
{買|か}い{物|もの}に{出|で}かけました。
{母|はは}は{出|で}かけています。

notes: Combines {出|で}る (to exit) and かける (to set about doing). Different from {出|で}る which simply means 'to exit/leave'. {出|で}かける implies going somewhere with purpose. {出|で}かけている means someone is currently out.
